home.title: Virtual Liberation War Museum
home.lead: Nine months that gave birth to a nation. Walk through the galleries, follow the timeline, trace the map and listen to the stories of 1971.
home.quote: “The struggle this time is the struggle for our emancipation; the struggle this time is the struggle for independence.”

museum.title: 3D Museum
museum.body: Walk through six galleries, from the Language Movement to the Hall of Memory.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: From Partition in 1947 to the homecoming of January 1972.

map.title: Map
map.body: The eleven sectors, refugee routes and the places where history happened.

stories.title: Stories
stories.body: Human stories of families, refugees and those who waited.

home.approachBody: This museum tells the story with dignity. Every fact links to a source, disputed figures are attributed, and graphic material is always behind a warning that you choose to open.

about.title: About this museum
about.purpose: The Virtual Liberation War Museum makes the history of 1971 accessible to anyone with a browser, in Bangla and English, on any device.
about.method: Every fact links to a source. When sources disagree, especially about the number of people killed, we show who says what instead of a single figure. We never create fake photographs, quotes or testimony.
about.warnings: The genocide gallery and some exhibits describe violence. They are marked, graphic material is hidden until you choose to see it, and you can always skip that gallery.
about.demo: This is a development build. Images are symbolic illustrations and the two stories are fictional composites. Before launch, all content will be replaced with verified archival material.
